entries.2c81401a62beb91d: This is a market category for the marine vessel market. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,423 million. Products are delivered to individual shipyards and include marine exhaust gas valves that comply with the IMO's NOx3 regulations, capturing needs in the environmental measures field.
entries.325de31a99f4e182: Revenue is derived from sales of valve products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,114 million, up 6.5% year on year, driven by higher revenue in the marine market, where sales of marine exhaust gas valves and LNG valves grew.
entries.37a313e4f355e7f9: The Second Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal year ended March 2026 to fiscal year ended March 2028), announced in May 2025, sets out three basic strategies: “expansion of existing business areas,” “development of overseas markets” and “challenges in new business areas.” In existing areas, it aims to deepen penetration of the domestic market through decarbonization-related products and higher added value, and overseas, it plans to accelerate global expansion centered on marine exhaust gas valves and LNG valves, with the aim of raising the overseas revenue ratio.
entries.40bdcd1ea17e4a5d: Its head office is in Yasu, Shiga Prefecture. It was founded in 1902 as a saw-cutting workshop and was established as Okumura Seisakusho Co., Ltd. in 1962. As of March 31, 2026, it had 371 employees and, together with 2 consolidated subsidiaries, forms a group. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.460dfa8eaadf4ca1: It operates a single segment, the valve manufacturing and sales business, manufacturing and selling fluid control equipment centered on butterfly valves. Markets are divided into marine and land-based, and sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,423 million for marine and ¥4,691 million for land-based. It handles more than 100,000 types of products through combinations of model, size, material, control method and other factors.
